d: "All my stuff under the Tangor name through 2024. I've added some previously unreleased images, things that I had maybe hoped to do more with at one time but never got around to or a few extras that were good enough to include. Since I've become pretty used to using G9 I'm probably not going to go back and do anything with the G8 characters. I also included some wonderful fanart or utilizations of my work done by artists on Baraag, namely JJFrenchie, G.F.D., and Mr. Macguffin."
